stem: Which of the following was primarily responsible for the change depicted in this illustration?

options.label: F
options.text: New immigrant screening procedures at Ellis Island

options.label: G
options.text: A crackdown on anarchism after the assassination of President William McKinley

options.label: H
options.text: Overseas expansion associated with the Spanish-American War

options.label: J
options.text: An increase in circulating currency after the discovery of gold in Nome, Alaska

visual_elements: Illustration titled “What Our Navy Costs Us,” 1909 showing a comparison between 1893 and 1909 with two men and two money bags: the smaller bag labeled $2,000,000 with population 66 million and Navy budget 22 million dollars in 1893, and the larger bag labeled $135,000,000 with population 89 million and Navy budget 135 million dollars in 1909.
